summary.text: Taylor Rehfeldt is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 14 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A registered nurse anesthetist, she faces Republican Tyler Tordsen and Democrat Erinn Williams for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her as Taylor Rae Rehfeldt.

paragraphs.text: Taylor Rehfeldt earned a bachelor's degree in nursing from South Dakota State University, a bachelor's degree in interdisciplinary science from the South Dakota School of Mines and Technology, and a master's degree and doctorate in nurse anesthesia practice from Mount Marty College, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as registered nurse anesthetist.
Rehfeldt took office on January 12, 2021, and Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the House Health and Human Services and Transportation committees.
It also lists her as vice chair of the Health and Human Services and State Affairs committees during the 2023-2024 session.
